round: V23: better stage-2 (3072->6144) training under official-modern rules
base: training/v7/base.ntd (stage 2 = website V4 stage 2); all arms start from this stage 2. Stage 3 used as frozen bootstrap = copy of base stage 2 inside training (as V21 S2).
trainingPool: pools/onpolicy.txt: states every 25 moves (max card 3072, alive) along the current website search (5-ply, cutoff 0.01, clamped, current model) continued from the 781 V21 train-3072 snapshots, rollout seeds 23100001+index.
common: 7200 CPU seconds each, run in parallel; TD(lambda=.5) five-step score return as V21; strong episodes = complete 3-ply expectimax with clamped leaves, chosen whenever their CPU share is below 25% (share of CPU, not of episodes: strong episodes are far slower); other episodes use the two-move policy.
deviationFromPlan: The plan said 'about 10% of games with a strong player'. Because a strong episode costs ~70x a two-move episode, the share is defined on CPU time (25%) instead; this gives ~0.1% of episodes but ~1/4 of training compute.
evalPools: First-3072 snapshots from new openings 23110001+ (complete 3-ply), in seed order: SCREEN = first 512, CONFIRM = next 2560. Disjoint from all training data.
screen: Arms A and B (stage 2 swapped into NEW-style model with V21 stage 3; website search with clamp) on SCREEN to first 6144 or death, rollout base 23310001. Pick the arm with more 6144s; tie -> A. No test.

confirm.compare: winner vs CUR (website model: base stages 0-2 + V21 stage 3), both with clamp, same search, on CONFIRM, rollout base 23320001
confirm.primary: P(reach 6144): exact two-sided McNemar at alpha 0.05 (single test)
confirm.interim: at 1280 pairs: stop early only if p < 0.001 (Haybittle-Peto)
confirm.secondary: mean score gained to 6144/death; avoidable-death audit fields

adoption: Adopt the winner's stage 2 into the website model if the primary is significant and positive.
frozenNote: hashes recorded after training, before any evaluation run
